title: 19th Annual Gateway City Turkey Trot Set for Thanksgiving Morning in Laredo
excerpt: The 19th Annual Gateway City Turkey Trot takes place Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, Nov. 26, with a 10K, a 5K and a Fun Run starting at 603 Shiloh Dr. in Laredo. Race proceeds go to the less fortunate in Laredo and surrounding areas.
content:
The 19th Annual Gateway City Turkey Trot — The Race for a Cause — is set for Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, in Laredo.

The City of Laredo announced the annual Thanksgiving tradition in a post Friday, Nov. 20, inviting residents to start the holiday with fitness, family fun and community spirit. The race offers a 10K, a 5K and a Fun Run, starting at 8 a.m. at 603 Shiloh Dr.

The race is organized by Jr. Hands Across South Texas, and race proceeds go to the less fortunate in the Laredo community and surrounding areas.

Registration is $35 through Nov. 25 and $50 on race day. Registration closes Nov. 25 at 11:59 p.m. Packet pickup is Wednesday, Nov. 25, from 4 to 7 p.m. at Orangetheory Fitness, 3502 E. Del Mar, Suite 6. Awards go to the overall and masters male and female winners in the 5K and 10K, plus age-group winners.

For race details and registration, visit the RunSignup page linked in the City's post.

Sources: City of Laredo - Government, Nov. 20, 2026; RunSignup race page.
